target: Pinned Primer React Dialog focus-hook delegation, guarded backdrop close, Escape and body scroll state
observed_behavior: The pinned _Dialog invokes imported useFocusTrap with containerRef=dialogRef, an initialFocusRef falling back to an auto-focused footer-button ref, restoreFocusOnCleanUp conditional on returnFocusRef.current, and returnFocusRef. It invokes imported useOnEscapePress with a callback that calls onClose('escape') and prevents the default event; DefaultHeader separately treats a close-button click as onClose('close-button') and intercepts Escape on the close button to call onClose('escape') while stopping propagation. A backdrop click calls onClose('escape') only when the click target equals the backdrop and the recorded mousedown also originated on the backdrop. A useEffect increments a shared dialogScrollDisabledCount, sets body scroll-state styling/attribute, and removes those attributes on cleanup when the count reaches zero. These are directly visible wiring and conditions.
